document.name: honeycomb-afm-bias020-fci-4x4-1x2-uv1248-main4c-round-barrier
document.objective: Full AFM scan restarted with reference_density_bias=0.2 at every initial and refinement point. U,V in {1,2,4,8}; at most 200 distinct points, four local refinement levels. Coordinate all-converged round barriers with the existing CDW Study.

notes: Separate AFM and CDW Studies; 4 CPUs, main, 16 concurrent tasks each (32 total).
Initial mixing 0.2, DIIS disabled; bath_spin_dimension_policy=max. Same-seed fallback mixing 0.1, max_iterations=400.
No next generation until both Studies have fully converged and passed required quality checks.
16 initial + at most 184 refinement points per Study; fallback Runs are additional.
This new Study replaces the bias=0.05 AFM Study in the shared round group; all old results are retained.
Recompute all 16 initial points, including the three points used in the separate bias test. No result reuse.
Reference density bias remains 0.2 during same-seed damping retries.

contract.label: block2 DMRG active-space solver

DMRG-CASSCF supports single-state optimization and state-averaged optimization of multiple roots in one spin and symmetry sector. Different-spin state averaging is not implemented yet.
Compatible cross-task continuation requires a joint optimized-orbital/MPS checkpoint; an expanded active space reuses only the optimized orbitals and initializes a fresh MPS.
Unrestricted active spaces and SC-NEVPT2 coupling are not implemented yet.

smearing.meaning: Set false for zero-temperature lattice SCF, density fitting and preliminary impurity SCF; beta is ignored when disabled.

beta.meaning: Finite positive inverse model-energy scale shared by CCSD preliminary impurity SCF, DMET lattice SCF and density fitting (Fermi width 1/beta). Applies only to CCSD-DMET.

contract.label: libDMET DMET
limitations: Restricted and fixed-spin unrestricted references are supported; libDMET Sz is Nalpha-Nbeta.
Nonzero-spin execution currently requires one translated representative fragment.
Ground-state DMET only; excited-state requests are not supported.
Interacting Schmidt baths are the default; the noninteracting-bath approximation must be requested explicitly.
The initial auxiliary correlation potential is fixed to zero; PM, AF, and FM affect only the self-consistent reference density.
Self-consistency requires representative-fragment energy, mean-field 1RDM, and density-fit residual convergence; correlation-potential changes remain diagnostic only.

Uniform chain/ring and square presets use the native translated lattice path. Periodic Builder graphs with complete primitive-cell metadata may use a translation-audited representative impurity, including multi-site cells.
Open, nonuniform, locally edited, extended-Hubbard, or translation-inequivalent Builder graphs preserve the original Hamiltonian through an explicit finite-graph fragment partition.
Builder primitive-cell metadata defines the default fragment for multi-site cells; impurity_shape and impurity_size are alternative selectors, not simultaneous inputs.
block2 DMRG uses a ground-state impurity solve with mandatory 1- and 2-RDMs and internal MPS continuation between DMET iterations.

impurity_solver_options.meaning: Provider-specific options: shared SCF/fitting beta for CCSD or opt-in FCI, or block2 schedules, ordering, threading, and memory.

impurity_shape.meaning: Fragment shape in Builder primitive-cell units; all basis sites in each selected cell are retained.

impurity_size.meaning: Sites per fragment for graphs without multi-site primitive-cell metadata.

impurity_site_ids.meaning: Convenience selector for one explicit impurity.

fragments.meaning: Canonical explicit fragment partition using Builder site ids.

reference.meaning: Unrestricted is the Hubbard default and uses the fixed Nalpha-Nbeta sector from ModelSpec.nelec.

execution_mode.meaning: Use one translated representative impurity or preserve the complete Builder graph as an explicit fragment partition.

fragment_definition.meaning: Use a primitive cell, a cell block, a site-count partition, or disjoint honeycomb six-site rings. honeycomb_hexagon uses finite-graph DMET and requires a compatible periodic lattice (e.g. 3x3 or 6x6 primitive cells, not 4x4). Do not combine it with other fragment selectors.

interacting_bath.meaning: Project lattice two-body interactions into the full embedding basis; false keeps interactions on the impurity only.

initial_correlation_potential.meaning: Start DMET from an unbiased zero auxiliary correlation potential.

reference_density_guess.meaning: Select only the initial reference-density seed (spin or sublattice-charge bias); vcor remains zero.

reference_density_source.meaning: Finite-graph warm start from a converged DMET mean-field density. Specify a Study source_case_id or an absolute artifact path with sha256. Overrides the analytic density seed; target U/V rebuild the physical baseline and the auxiliary correction starts at zero.

reference_density_bias.meaning: Staggered seed amplitude used by AF (spin density) and CDW (charge density, per spin) initialization.

correlation_potential_mixing.meaning: Fraction of the proposed outer DMET correlation-potential update retained after optional DIIS; 1 disables damping.

diis_enabled.meaning: Enable outer DMET DIIS extrapolation; independent of impurity SCF DIIS.

energy_tolerance.meaning: Native libDMET threshold for the DMET energy change.

density_tolerance.meaning: Native libDMET threshold for the maximum consecutive mean-field 1RDM change.

density_fit_tolerance.meaning: Diagnostic limit for the mismatch between the correlated embedding density and the auxiliary mean-field density; reported in quality checks, not a convergence criterion.

bath_spin_dimension_policy.meaning: For finite-graph noninteracting eigenvalue baths, complete the smaller spin bath to the larger dimension with omitted orthonormal environment eigenvectors.

impurity_scf_diis.meaning: Use DIIS in preliminary impurity SCF: native DIIS for FCI, ADIIS/CDIIS blending for CCSD. CCSD requires converged SCF before proceeding. The block2 bridge has no preliminary SCF.
